text:
marina: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add a short troubleshooting section about SELinux + cgroup v2 interactions for the private installer. Main ask: a systemd unit drop-in example for the KMS socket + a note on filecontext / fcontext restore. tagging @raj for unit snippet and @sasha for SDK/samples check

raj: Ack. I can paste a minimal systemd drop-in and a SELinux fcontext command. Do we want to recommend creating a dedicated user for the socket or use existing `redwood` user? :thinking_face:

sasha: Dedicated user is safer for private installs. Also remind folks to `restorecon` in airgapped flows where the RPM/installer might not run semanage. We should include the `chown`/`chmod` commands folks can run manually.

marina: Agreed. Draft snippet below — feel free to tweak. This will go under "Private installer -> Network & Security -> KMS/HSM"

marina: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.socket.d/10-selinux.conf
[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/redwood/kms.sock
Service=redwood-kms.service

# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-resource.conf
[Service]
User=redwoodsvc
Group=redwoodsvc
Slice=redwood.slice
LimitNOFILE=65536
```

marina: ```bash
# Fix ownership/permissions if installer couldn't set them (airgapped manual step)
sudo mkdir -p /var/run/redwood
sudo chown redwoodsvc:redwoodsvc /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
sudo chmod 0660 /var/run/redwood/kms.sock

# SELinux filecontext (RHEL/CentOS): only add if selinux=enabled
sudo semanage fcontext -a -t container_var_run_t '/var/run/redwood(/.*)?'
sudo restorecon -R /var/run/redwood
```

raj: Looks good. Two small additions: (1) add a note for systemd `Slice` so ops can throttle KMS if needed, (2) mention cgroup v2 vs v1: include a short line saying installers on older hosts may still be on cgroup v1 and recommend v2 for predictable resource assignment.

eng-platform: Also add a short paragraph about rootless runtimes: Podman/CRI-O might create sockets under different ownership and require `--userns=keep-id` or explicit `--tmpfs` mounts. Suggest a tested example for podman flows — at least a pointer.

james: tiny nit: use `container_var_run_t` is broad; secops will ask for PKCS#11 path restrictions. @secops-bot any quick guidance?

secops-bot: recommendation: document PKCS11 socket path hardening (restrict to group redwoodsvc, SELinux context, and avoid symlinked directories). Add a short checklist: uid/gid, fcontext, no world-write, verify checksums for installer artifacts.

marina: Good call. I'll add the checklist and a short Podman note. Will push an updated branch in ~30m and link PR here.

docs-bot: CI started for branch marina/selinux-cgroup-kms-docs (build docs preview). :gear:

marina: Pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287 — includes the snippets above plus a one-paragraph troubleshooting flow for airgapped installs (manual semanage/restorecon).

sasha: Reviewing now. If we can keep the airgap section under 5 bullets (what to run, why, common errors) that will help readers. Also add an explicit `setenforce` note: do not suggest disabling SELinux permanently; instead show permissive for debug only.

james: Approved for style. Left one inline suggestion to link to the "Installer preflight" page for user creation.

secops-bot: Security review scheduled — low-risk docs-only change. Reminder: if we add `semanage` commands, include fallback instructions for distros without `policycoreutils-python-utils`.

marina: Thanks everyone. I'll incorporate the fallbacks (rpm/debian package names) and the podman note, re-run preview, and ping for final. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI passed — preview deployed at https://docs-internal.redwood.ai/preview/4287 (expires in 24h).

marina: Final question — do we want a brief note in the Dedicated/Docker images compatibility matrix about images built with `chcon` vs fcontext? Might prevent confusion during upgrades.

eng-platform: Yes, add a row: "SELinux integration" with guidance per platform (RHEL: fcontext + restorecon; Debian: AppArmor note + file perms). Keep it concise.

marina: Will do. Thanks all, I'll update the PR and mark for merge after secops review.
